contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES DOMIT AVG GERM P M TRP VII

A possible mule of a Roman silver denarius of Domitian, dating from AD 88 (Reece period 4). IMP . XIIII COS . XIIII CENS . P . P . P . reverse type depicting Minerva right on prow, brandishing javelin and holding shield. Mint of Rome.
